sentences.en: For the past 18 months, Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth has remade the top ranks of the
sentences.zh: 在过去的18个月里，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯重组了美军高层，

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military, dismissing or sidelining many whose rise, he believes, was aided by DEI.
sentences.zh: 军方，他解雇或排挤了许多他认为靠多元、平等和包容（DEI）政策上位的人。

sentences.en: And replacing them with officers who fit his definition of merit.
sentences.zh: 并用符合他“任人唯贤”定义的高级军官取而代之。

sentences.en: In the process, many argue, Hegseth is prioritizing loyalty to him and his ideas over loyalty to the military itself.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，许多人认为，海格塞斯将对个人及理念的忠诚置于对军队本身的忠诚之上。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague, Greg Jaffe, takes us inside the hiring and firing for a single job that's become a case study for Hegseth's approach.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事格雷格·贾菲将带我们深入了解一个特定职位的招聘与解雇过程，它已成为海格塞斯用人方法的典型案例。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: Greg, welcome to The Daily.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，欢迎来到《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I know this is your first time on the show, so glad to have you.
sentences.zh: 我知道这是你第一次上这个节目，很高兴有你加入。

sentences.en: Yeah, thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢邀请我。

sentences.en: Pleasure is all mine.
sentences.zh: 我的荣幸。

sentences.en: So, I think it's fair to say that Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth's desire to transform the senior ranks of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想可以公平地说，国防部长皮特·海格塞斯重组美国高级军官队伍的愿望，

sentences.en: military is pretty well established by now.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是板上钉钉的事了。

sentences.en: So, why did you decide to pursue this story?
sentences.zh: 那么，你为什么决定追踪这个故事？

sentences.en: So, we knew that when Secretary Hegseth came in, and even before he came in, he talked about
sentences.zh: 所以，我们知道当海格塞斯部长上任时，甚至在他上任之前，他就谈到过

sentences.en: wanting to remove senior military officers, including the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
sentences.zh: 想要撤换高级军官，包括参谋长联席会议主席。

sentences.en: And then, in September of last year, he gives a big speech in which he, again, talks about the
sentences.zh: 然后，在去年9月，他发表了一场大型演讲，在演讲中他再次谈到

sentences.en: need to clean house, to remove people who he thinks have been inserted into the military by
sentences.zh: 进行彻底清洗的必要性，撤换那些他认为被意识形态推入军队、

sentences.en: ideologues and have been manipulated into pursuing, like, diversity, equity, and inclusion prograMs.
sentences.zh: 并被操纵去推行类似多元、平等和包容项目的人。

sentences.en: No more identity months, DEI offices.
sentences.zh: 不再有什么身份认同月，不再有DEI办公室。

sentences.en: And so, it's a really broad campaign to sort of reclaim a military that he thinks has been taken over by leftist forces.
sentences.zh: 因此，这是一场非常广泛的运动，旨在夺回他认为已被左翼力量接管的军队。

sentences.en: And I think he blames, in some cases, the losses in Iraq and Afghanistan on the sort of the corruption of the officer corps of the United States military.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，在某些情况下，他将伊拉克和阿富汗的失利归咎于美国军队官僚阶层的腐败。

sentences.en: And so, he's going to fix that problem.
sentences.zh: 所以，他要解决这个问题。

sentences.en: We are clearing out the debris.
sentences.zh: 我们正在清理残渣。

sentences.en: You might say we're ending the war on warriors.
sentences.zh: 你也可以说我们正在结束对勇士的战争。

sentences.en: And some of that happens in 2025.
sentences.zh: 其中一部分发生在2025年。

sentences.en: Within his first month, he fires a large number of people.
sentences.zh: 在他上任的第一个月内，他就解雇了大量人员。

sentences.en: Vice Chief of Staff were all fired Friday night.
sentences.zh: 副参谋长都在周五晚上被解雇了。

sentences.en: And no specific explanations were given.
sentences.zh: 而且没有给出具体的解释。

sentences.en: It's a pretty significant purge of some of the top ranks of the military.
sentences.zh: 这是对军队最高层的一次相当重大的清洗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We did a whole episode about CQ Brown, for example, the chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff, who was fired in this first wave.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们曾就参谋长联席会议主席CQ·布朗做过一整期节目，他在第一波浪潮中就被解雇了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But I think we really start to see it in 2026, where the firings are continuing.
sentences.zh: 但我想我们真正开始看到这一点是在2026年，当时解雇仍在继续。

sentences.en: Hexeth has fired more than a dozen generals and admirals since he took over as secretary.
sentences.zh: 海格塞斯自担任部长以来，已经解雇了十多位将军和海军上将。

sentences.en: And he's blocking large numbers of people, women and people of color, from getting promotions that they had earned at senior levels.
sentences.zh: 他还在阻止大量女性和有色人种获得他们凭借能力在高级职位上赢得的晋升。

sentences.en: And so, Kate Kelly and I, who had been working on this, we'd found upwards of 65 to 70 people who had been either fired or blocked from promotions that they had earned.
sentences.zh: 因此，一直在跟进此事的凯特·凯利和我，发现了多达65到70人被解雇或被剥夺了他们应得的晋升。

sentences.en: And that's about 10% of the entire general officer corps, which is, you know, admirals and generals.
sentences.zh: 这大约占整个将官核心层（也就是海军上将和将军）的10%。

sentences.en: Huge!
sentences.zh: 太惊人了！

sentences.en: Yep, yep.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: But in reality, it's probably higher.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，这个数字可能更高。

sentences.en: So, this is about as wide-ranging a house cleaning as one could imagine.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是一次人们能想象到的最大规模的大换血。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've been covering the military since 1999, off and on.
sentences.zh: 是的，我断断续续报道军队已经从1999年开始了。

sentences.en: And I cannot think of anything remotely close to this in the last 26 years.
sentences.zh: 在过去的26年里，我想不出有任何事情能与此相比。

sentences.en: And given all that, we wanted to understand both what it took to fall out of favor with
sentences.zh: 鉴于这一切，我们既想了解怎样做才会失宠于海格塞斯部长，

sentences.en: Secretary Hexeth, but also to understand what it took to get hired in this Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 也想了解在这个五角大楼里什么样的人才会被录用。

sentences.en: And that's what led us to the story of Lisa Franchetti and Daryl Caudill, hoping it would help us understand, in a broad sense,
sentences.zh: 这就是我们追踪丽莎·弗兰切蒂和达里尔·考迪尔的故事的原因，我们希望这能帮助我们在宏观上理解，

sentences.en: how Secretary Hexeth was really changing the military in ways that were really transformative.
sentences.zh: 海格塞斯部长究竟是如何以一种深刻变革的方式改变军队的。

sentences.en: So, let's start with what you found about Lisa Franchetti, the member of that duo who was fired by Hexeth.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从你关于丽莎·弗兰切蒂的发现开始，她是二人中被海格塞斯解雇的那位。

sentences.en: What did you find out about her?
sentences.zh: 你关于她发现了什么？

sentences.en: So, Admiral Franchetti has told her story in lots of interviews about how she grew up in
sentences.zh: 弗兰切蒂上将在许多采访中都讲述过她的故事：她成长于纽约州罗切斯特，

sentences.en: Rochester, New York, and she went to Northwestern University, which is not the normal path, necessarily, for naval officers.
sentences.zh: 并且就读于西北大学，这对于海军军官来说不一定是一条常规的道路。

sentences.en: When I was 17, I was going to Medill, the most amazing journalism school in the country, and I was going to be a reporter.
sentences.zh: 当我17岁时，我正要去读梅迪尔新闻学院，那是全国最棒的新闻学院，我原本打算成为一名记者。

sentences.en: She was a coxswain on the rowing team, and so her job was to command the men rowing their boat.
sentences.zh: 她是赛艇队的舵手，她的工作是指挥男队员划船。

sentences.en: Oh, my gosh.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: So, I learned a lot about leadership.
sentences.zh: 所以我学到了很多关于领导力的知识。

sentences.en: You know, you have all these incredibly powerful individual athletes, but you need to get them to become part of the team.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你拥有所有这些极其强大的个人运动员，但你需要让他们成为团队的一部分。

sentences.en: You know, I think that was about the extent of her naval experience prior to that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我想这就是她之前海军经历的全部了。

sentences.en: But what happened is I was...
sentences.zh: 但发生的事情是……

sentences.en: But one day, she met a group of guys on campus who had decided to join the Navy to help pay for school.
sentences.zh: 但有一天，她在校园里遇到了一群决定加入海军来帮助支付学费的小伙子。

sentences.en: And I said, really?
sentences.zh: 我说，真的吗？

sentences.en: Tell me more.
sentences.zh: 多跟我讲讲。

sentences.en: And they talked about free textbooks, a chance to see the world.
sentences.zh: 他们谈到了免费教科书，以及看世界的机会。

sentences.en: And a recruiter sold her on the adventure of the armed forces.
sentences.zh: 一位招聘人员向她推销了武装部队的冒险经历。

sentences.en: And he told me all kinds of amazing stories, sea stories, as I now know them, about the Navy.
sentences.zh: 他给我讲了各种各样精彩的故事，也就是我现在所知道的海军传奇故事。

sentences.en: And I signed up on the spot.
sentences.zh: 我当场就报名了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's a story, actually, of a lot of people who joined the service, who don't have an intimate familiarity with it,
sentences.zh: 事实上，这正是许多加入军队的人的故事，他们对军队并没有深入的了解，

sentences.en: but are looking for some way to get ahead in their life, some benefit, and some sense of adventure.
sentences.zh: 而只是在寻找一种在生活中取得进展的途径、一些福利以及一种冒险感。

sentences.en: But I stayed for the mission.
sentences.zh: 但我留下来是为了使命。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And just a chance to serve something greater than myself.
sentences.zh: 仅仅是为了一个服务比自己更伟大的事业的机会。

sentences.en: I want to pull a thread out of that.
sentences.zh: 我想顺着这个话题继续深入。

sentences.en: And what is her experience once she joins the Navy?
sentences.zh: 她加入海军后的经历是怎样的？

sentences.en: When she joins, it's the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 她加入的时候是20世纪80年代。

sentences.en: And so there's still, at that point, something called the combat exclusion ban that's in place.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个时候，仍然存在一项名为“战斗禁令”的规定。

sentences.en: And that prevents women from serving on combat ships or serving in combat aircraft.
sentences.zh: 该规定禁止女性在战斗舰艇上服役或在战斗机上服役。

sentences.en: And really limits the opportunity of women to ascend to high ranks in the service.
sentences.zh: 这确实限制了女性在军队中晋升到高层的机会。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So when she arrives at the Navy, women, they can't even be on the ships that we most identify
sentences.zh: 所以当她来到海军时，女性甚至不能登上我们最认同为海军象征的舰艇上，

sentences.en: with the Navy itself, which to me sounds a little bit like being drafted to play professional basketball and being told that you can never go on the court.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，这有点像被征召去打职业篮球，却被告知你永远不能上场比赛。

sentences.en: It's a pretty big deal.
sentences.zh: 这可是一件大事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there's an interesting moment.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: So I think in 1989, she's one of 184 female surface warfare officers in the entire United
sentences.zh: 我想在1989年，她是整个美国海军中仅有的184名女性水面作战军官之一。

sentences.en: States Navy.
sentences.zh: 美国海军。

sentences.en: And one of those officers was chosen to command an auxiliary logistics ship.
sentences.zh: 其中一名军官被选中去指挥一艘辅助后勤舰。

sentences.en: So this is a— Not a combat ship.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一艘——不是战斗舰。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And it's such a big event that the chief of naval operations, the job that Franchetti will someday hold, writes a letter to all 184 female officers saying,
sentences.zh: 这是一个如此重大的事件，以至于海军作战部长（弗兰切蒂日后将担任的职位）写信给所有184名女性军官，说道：

sentences.en: I look forward to the day soon when this will cease to be a special event.
sentences.zh: 我期待着这样一天的到来，不久之后，这就不再是一件特殊事件了。

sentences.en: And so she's at a moment where things are just beginning to open up for women in the
sentences.zh: 所以她正处于一个对于美国海军女性来说一切才刚刚开始敞开大门的时刻。

sentences.en: United States Navy.
sentences.zh: 美国海军。

sentences.en: And it sounds like at pretty senior levels of the military, leaders want it to keep opening up from the content of that letter.
sentences.zh: 从那封信的内容听起来，在军队的相当高层，领导层希望继续开放下去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But that view isn't universally held.
sentences.zh: 但这种观点并非普遍存在。

sentences.en: And it certainly wasn't universally held in the 1980s.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪80年代，它当然也不是普遍存在的。

sentences.en: The boss that I had at the time, he made it very clear to me that he didn't think women should be on our ship.
sentences.zh: 我当时的老板向我明确表示，他认为女性不应该上我们的船。

sentences.en: And he was going to make sure that I did not succeed.
sentences.zh: 他要确保我不会成功。

sentences.en: Franchetti says she's basically told by her commanding officer that this experiment of having women on ships is not going to go anywhere.
sentences.zh: 弗兰切蒂说，她的指挥官基本上告诉她，让女性上船的这个实验是不会有任何结果的。

sentences.en: How did you deal with it, being discriminated against, knowing that a boss didn't want you to succeed?
sentences.zh: 面对歧视，明知上司不希望你成功，你是如何应对的？

sentences.en: I just worked harder.
sentences.zh: 我只是更加努力工作。

sentences.en: And, you know, I was going to make sure that what he wanted to have happen wasn't going to happen.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我要确保他希望发生的事情不会发生。

sentences.en: That attitude fuels her.
sentences.zh: 这种态度激励了她。

sentences.en: It makes her work harder.
sentences.zh: 这促使她更加努力工作。

sentences.en: And in the 90s, Clinton lifts the combat exclusion ban.
sentences.zh: 在90年代，克林顿取消了战斗禁令。

sentences.en: And that allows women to serve on combat vessels and in combat aircraft.
sentences.zh: 这允许女性在战斗舰艇和战斗机上服役。

sentences.en: And it really opens up possibilities for somebody like Admiral Franchetti, who then seizes that opportunity and rises up through the Navy.
sentences.zh: 这确实为像弗兰切蒂上将这样的人打开了可能性，她随后抓住了这个机会，在海军中不断晋升。

sentences.en: You were a destroyer captain, as was I.
sentences.zh: 你曾是一名驱逐舰舰长，我也是。

sentences.en: You were commander of Destroyer Squadron 21.
sentences.zh: 你曾任第21驱逐舰中队指挥官。

sentences.en: The Rampant Lions.
sentences.zh: “横行雄狮”中队。

sentences.en: You were the Lion Queen.
sentences.zh: 你是狮子女王。

sentences.en: She commands an Arleigh Burke-class destroyer, the USS Ross.
sentences.zh: 她指挥过一艘阿利·伯克级驱逐舰“罗斯”号。

sentences.en: Later, two aircraft carrier strike groups.
sentences.zh: 后来又指挥了两个航母打击群。

sentences.en: You know, the aircraft carrier is really central to the way the United States Navy fights.
sentences.zh: 你知道，航空母舰确实是美国海军作战的核心。

sentences.en: And so in 2013, she's the first woman to actually command naval forces in Korea, which is a real hotspot at that moment.
sentences.zh: 所以在2013年，她成为第一位真正指挥韩国海军力量的女性，那在当时是一个真正的热点地区。

sentences.en: And she also is a senior officer on the joint staff in the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 她还担任过五角大楼联合参谋部的高级军官。

sentences.en: So in a relatively short amount of time, Franchetti goes from not being allowed onto combat ships to commanding those same ships.
sentences.zh: 所以在相对较短的时间内，弗兰切蒂从不被允许登上战斗舰艇变成了指挥这些舰艇。

sentences.en: And I imagine by this point, the word is out that she may be boss, boss material.
sentences.zh: 我想到了这个时候，消息已经传开，她具备了当大佬的潜质。

sentences.en: Yeah, and in 2023, she's officially put up for the job, the top job in the Navy.
sentences.zh: 是的，在2023年，她被正式提名担任海军最高职务。

sentences.en: You know, the Navy secretary selects three or four people who he thinks would be good for that job
sentences.zh: 你知道，海军部长挑选三四名他认为适合该职位的人选，

sentences.en: and submits that list to the secretary of defense, who at the time was a guy named Lloyd Austin.
sentences.zh: 并将该名单提交给国防部长，当时的国防部长是一个叫劳埃德·奥斯汀的人。

sentences.en: And after that list is put together, she's sort of widely rumored inside the Pentagon to be the frontrunner.
sentences.zh: 在这份名单拟定之后，五角大楼内部广泛传言她是领跑者。

sentences.en: But Austin looks at the list and he picks somebody else, a guy named Sam Paparo, who was a senior Navy officer in the Pacific.
sentences.zh: 但奥斯汀看了看名单，挑了另一个人，一个名叫萨姆·帕帕罗的高级海军军官，他在太平洋地区任职。

sentences.en: That's Austin's first choice.
sentences.zh: 那是奥斯汀的第一选择。

sentences.en: And when it goes to the White House, it's leaked to the press.
sentences.zh: 当它传到白宫时，消息泄露给了媒体。

sentences.zh: 我认为不仅弗兰切蒂上社会会反对这一点，而且我认为大多数各个军种的负责人都会对这种接触方式感到问题重重。

sentences.en: And so when you have people short-circuiting the process and auditioning for jobs, it really starts to undermine trust in the institution.
sentences.zh: 你知道，海军中有一个概念，一句俗语：舰艇、同袍、自我。

sentences.en: And I think not just Admiral Franchetti would have objected to that, but I think most of the chiefs of any of the services would have had a problem with that kind of outreach.
sentences.zh: 这其中的核心是，你舰艇的生存和成功永远排在第一位。

sentences.en: You know, there's a concept in the Navy, a saying, it goes ship, shipmate, self.
sentences.zh: 其次是你的水手，你的同袍，与你并肩作战的人，而你把自己放在最后。

sentences.en: And at the core of that is that the survival and success of your ship comes firSt.
sentences.zh: 当你将军队政治化，当你把意识形态或野心置于这些事情之上时，你实际上就开始瓦解塑造有效战斗力量的纽带。

sentences.en: The next is your sailors, your shipmates, the people who you serve with, and you put yourself laSt.
sentences.zh: 那些让人们愿意为更伟大的事业牺牲生命的纽带。

sentences.en: And when you politicize the force, when you put ideology or ambition ahead of those things, you really start to break down the bonds that make for an effective fighting force.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: The bonds that make people willing to sacrifice their lives for something bigger.
sentences.zh: 科特尔的这种接触有什么结果吗？

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先发生的事情是海格塞斯解雇了弗兰切蒂。

sentences.en: And what comes of Caudill's outreach?
sentences.zh: 记住，此时他上任才一个月左右，所以他还是个新人。

sentences.en: Well, the first thing that happens is Hegseth fires Franchetti.
sentences.zh: 他收到了三名候选人的名单，这些人是海军认为应该得到这个职位的人选。

sentences.en: And remember, at this time, he's only about a month into the job, so he's still pretty new.
sentences.zh: 科特尔上将不在那份名单上。

sentences.en: He gets a list of three nominees of people who the Navy thinks should get this job.
sentences.zh: 因此，五角大楼召开了一次会议，向海格塞斯简要介绍了海军推荐的三种选择。

sentences.en: Admiral Caudill is not on that liSt.
sentences.zh: 他看着那份名单说，科特尔在哪里？

sentences.en: And so there's a meeting in the Pentagon in which Hegseth is briefed on the sort of the three options that the Navy is recommending.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And he looks at that list and says, where's Caudill?
sentences.zh: 潜在地，甚至可能是因为他想起了这位海军高级将领发来的一条条短信和电子邮件，里面都在说，我是你的人，我跟你是一伙的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Potentially, or even probably because he's remembering all these texts and emails that are coming through from this very senior Navy guy saying, I'm your guy, and I'm with you.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，科特尔上将是海格塞斯部长面试海军作战部长职位的唯一一个人选。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And it turns out that Admiral Caudill is the only person that Secretary Hegseth interviews for the chief of naval operations job.
sentences.zh: 于是他选中了他。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 他的提名正准备送往白宫，这时出现了一个问题。

sentences.en: And so he picks him.
sentences.zh: 是什么问题？

sentences.en: His nomination is set to go to the White House when a problem arises.
sentences.zh: 原来科特尔上将身上有一起针对他的重大督察长投诉。

sentences.en: Which is what?
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So Admiral Caudill has a significant inspector general complaint against him.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一年前的事了，但一直压在系统里，需要处理一下。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 当你说督察长时，听起来基本上是指海军内部类似人力资源的世界。

sentences.en: It's essentially a year old, but it's been sitting in the system, and it needs to be dealt with.
sentences.zh: 督察长就是内部的监督机构。

sentences.en: This is, when you say inspector general, you basically mean like the kind of internal HR world of the Navy, it sounds like.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的情况是，该投诉围绕着他在一次颁奖晚宴上对水手们说的一些言论展开。

sentences.en: The IG is the internal watchdog.
sentences.zh: 督察长就是内部的监督机构。

sentences.en: So what happens is the complaint centers around some remarks he made to sailors at essentially an awards banquet.
sentences.zh: 所以发生的情况是，该投诉围绕着他在一次颁奖晚宴上对水手们说的一些言论展开。

sentences.en: And they're talking about the Navy's sexual assault awareness program.
sentences.zh: 他们正在谈论海军的性骚扰防范项目。

sentences.en: And Caudill says, look, if I strip naked and cover myself in honey and go walking through the forest and I get attacked by a bear, I have some responsibility for that attack.
sentences.zh: 考迪说，听着，如果我脱光衣服，身上涂满蜂蜜，然后走进森林，结果被熊袭击了，我对这次袭击是要承担一些责任的。

sentences.en: Another one that he uses is, you know, if I put on gold chains and a fancy gold watch and I go walking through Harlem and I get assaulted, you know,
sentences.zh: 他举的另一个例子是，你知道，如果我戴上金链子和名贵的金表，然后走进哈林区，结果遭到袭击，你知道，

sentences.en: I bear some responsibility for my decisions.
sentences.zh: 我对自己的决定要承担一些责任。

sentences.en: So eventually, some of the sailors who hear these remarks complain to the IG.
sentences.zh: 所以最终，一些听到这些言论的水兵向总监察长进行了投诉。

sentences.en: Greg, I'm thinking back to the email that Caudill wrote to Hegseth where he says, I'm with you on being anti-woke and changing the culture of the military.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，我回想起考迪写给海格塞斯的电子邮件，他在信中说，我支持你反对“觉醒”文化以及改变军队文化的立场。

sentences.en: And it sounds like with these kinds of comments, he's definitely not on board with the progressive culture that has arrived in places like the U.S.
sentences.zh: 听起来，通过发表这些言论，他绝对不赞同那些已经渗透到美国等地方的进步主义文化，

sentences.en: military that would say that comments like that are not appropriate.
sentences.zh: 这种文化认为诸如此类的言论是不合适的。

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我想确实如此。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And so when Admiral Caudill has to deal with this, he reaches out to a lawyer named Tim Parlatore.
sentences.zh: 因此，当考迪海军上将不得不处理这件事时，他联系了一位名叫蒂姆·帕拉托雷的律师。

sentences.en: Parlatore has represented other naval officers dealing with these IG complaints.
sentences.zh: 帕拉托雷曾代表其他处理这些总监察长投诉的海军军官。

sentences.en: He also represented Secretary Hegseth when Secretary Hegseth was accused of sexual assault a few years ago.
sentences.zh: 几年前海格塞斯部长被指控性骚扰时，他也曾担任海格塞斯的辩護律师。

sentences.en: Now he's working as a special advisor inside the Pentagon.
sentences.zh: 现在他在五角大楼内担任特别顾问。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So Caudill's connections to Hegseth keep getting bigger and more complicated.
sentences.zh: 所以考迪与海格塞斯的联系越来越紧密，也越来越复杂。

sentences.en: So at this point, where does Caudill's nomination stand?
sentences.zh: 那么在目前这个阶段，考迪的提名处于什么状态？

sentences.en: Where does it go?
sentences.zh: 接下来会怎么样？

sentences.en: So the IG concludes that he didn't do anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 总监察长认定他没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: And then that clears the pathway for Admiral Caudill's nomination to go to the White House.
sentences.zh: 这为考迪海军上将的提名呈交白宫扫清了道路。

sentences.en: Good morning, everyone.
sentences.zh: 大家早上好。

sentences.en: This ceremony marks an important transition for our Navy.
sentences.zh: 这场仪式标志着我们海军的一次重要过渡。

sentences.en: So last summer, summer of 2025, he succeeds Admiral Franchetti and becomes the new Chief of Naval Operations.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，即2025年夏天，他接替弗兰凯蒂海军上将，成为新任海军作战部长。

sentences.en: With the promise to work every day to make our sailors better warriors, our families more supported, and our...
sentences.zh: 他承诺每天努力让我们的水兵成为更好的战士，让我们的家庭得到更多支持，以及我们的……

sentences.en: And in his speech, he brings up this idea of sailors first and serving with integrity.
sentences.zh: 在演讲中，他提出了水兵至上和以诚信服役的理念。

sentences.en: Sailors are my priority.
sentences.zh: 水兵是我的首要任务。

sentences.en: I pledge to lead with integrity, honor, and resolve.
sentences.zh: 我承诺以诚信、荣誉和决心领导队伍。

sentences.en: And he also parrots Hegseth's language of domination and strength.
sentences.zh: 他还重复了海格塞斯关于支配地位和力量的言论。

sentences.en: To ensure that our Navy remains and forever will be the most dominant, lethal, and credible maritime fighting force the world has ever known.
sentences.zh: 确保我们的海军现在以及永远都是世界上有史以来最具支配力、最致命、最可靠的海上战斗力量。

sentences.en: Now let's get to work.
sentences.zh: 现在让我们开始工作吧。

sentences.en: Greg, help make sense of this firing and this hiring.
sentences.zh: 格雷格，请帮我们分析一下这次撤换和任命的来龙去脉。

sentences.en: We start with Lisa Franchetti, who President Biden picks, I think pretty self-consciously, because he wants to have a woman in that role.
sentences.zh: 我们从丽莎·弗兰凯蒂开始，我认为拜登总统选择她是相当刻意的，因为他希望由女性来担任这个角色。

sentences.en: Hegseth comes along and says, that's not how I'm going to be doing business, so fires her, and picks Caudill,
sentences.zh: 海格塞斯出现后表示，我不会那样做事，于是解雇了她，并选择了考迪，

sentences.en: it seems in large part because Caudill shares Hegseth's ideology and has found multiple ways to communicate that.
sentences.zh: 这很大程度上是因为考迪与海格塞斯有着共同的意识形态，并且已经通过多种方式表达了这一点。

sentences.en: So how should we be thinking about all of that together?
sentences.zh: 那么我们应该如何整体看待这一切呢？

sentences.en: Yeah, I should note that spokesmen for both Secretary Hegseth and Admiral Caudill have said that these decisions were made on merit.
sentences.zh: 是的，我需要指出的是，海格塞斯部长和考迪海军上将的发言人都表示，这些决定是基于能力做出的。

sentences.en: But it seems pretty clear that the firings were not about merit.
sentences.zh: 但很明显，这些撤换并非基于能力。

sentences.en: You know, it's completely legitimate to fire somebody for competence if they make a mistake or lose a war.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果有人犯了错或者打了败仗，因其能力不足而将其实施解雇完全是合情合理的。

sentences.en: But Franchetti did nothing wrong, as far as we can tell.
sentences.zh: 但就我们所知，弗兰凯蒂并没有做错任何事。

sentences.en: She was fired, and Caudill was hired, at least in part for reasons tied to politics or ideology.
sentences.zh: 她被解雇而考迪被任命，至少有一部分原因与政治或意识形态有关。

sentences.en: And that's a really dangerous place for the military to go.
sentences.zh: 对于军队来说，这是一个非常危险的方向。

sentences.en: And dangerous exactly why?
sentences.zh: 为什么说这极其危险？

sentences.en: Because I guess there must be plenty of people who imagine that other senior military officials have found ways to ingratiate themselves with military leaders and to communicate that,
sentences.zh: 因为我想，肯定有很多人会认为，其他高级军事官员也已经找到了迎合军事领导层并传达这样一种信息的方法，即

sentences.en: you know, I'm your person.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我是你的人。

sentences.en: Why does what happened here seem so problematic?
sentences.zh: 为什么这里发生的事情看起来如此令人担忧？

sentences.en: Well, I think when you start firing people for political reasons, it's not just the person you fire, but it's the message that sends throughout the entire force that, hey,
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为当你开始出于政治原因解雇他人时，这不仅仅针对被解雇的那个人，它还向整个军队传递了一个信号，那就是，

sentences.en: if you want to move up, if you want to succeed, there are political litmus tests or political gates that you have to pass through.
sentences.zh: 如果你想晋升，如果你想成功，你必须通过某些政治纯洁性测试或政治门槛。

sentences.en: And then you start making day-to-day decisions, maybe even really important military ones, based on will this make the boss happy?
sentences.zh: 然后你开始做出日常决策，甚至可能是非常重要的军事决策，依据的竟然是“这会让老板高兴吗”？

sentences.en: Because that's kind of how I got my job in the first place.
sentences.zh: 因为我当初得到这份工作差不多就是靠这个。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: War is a really tough, complicated endeavor, as we're seeing in Iran right now.
sentences.zh: 正如我们现在在伊朗看到的那样，战争是一项非常艰难、复杂的任务。

sentences.en: And so you want your best warfighters, not your most politically aligned warfighters, to be promoted.
sentences.zh: 所以你希望晋升的是最优秀的战斗人员，而不是政治立场最一致的战斗人员。

sentences.en: You want people to be able to tell the boss when they're wrong.
sentences.zh: 你希望人们在老板犯错时敢于直言。

sentences.en: You want senior officers to provide unvarnished military advice, even when it may not be popular or what the civilians want to hear.
sentences.zh: 你希望高级军官提供不加粉饰的军事建议，哪怕这些建议可能并不受欢迎，也不是文职官员想听到的。

sentences.en: Now, have other administrations initially distrusted the generals they inherited from past presidents?
sentences.zh: 那么，其他政府是否也曾在上台之初不信任前几任总统遗留的将军？

sentences.en: Yes, that has happened.
sentences.zh: 是的，这种情况确实发生过。

sentences.en: But they never took steps to fire and replace them with more ideologically aligned officers, because they knew it was a really slippery slope.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未采取过将其实施解雇，并换上意识形态更一致的军官这样的行动，因为他们知道这是一条极其危险的滑坡。

sentences.en: It could lead to places that weren't good for the military or for the country.
sentences.zh: 这可能会将军队或国家带向不好的境地。

sentences.en: I just want to end by spending a moment on the other side of this tale.
sentences.zh: 最后我想花点时间谈谈这个故事的另一面。

sentences.en: Well, the person we started this episode with, and that is Lisa Franchetti, and the demography of the military.
sentences.zh: 也就是我们这期节目开篇提到的人，丽莎·弗兰凯蒂，以及军队的人口结构。

sentences.en: Because the reason why all the changes were made to let her rise up through the ranks,
sentences.zh: 因为当初之所以做出所有这些改变来让她在军阶中不断晋升，

sentences.en: and the reason why ultimately it seems President Biden put so much emphasis on having her be in that role,
sentences.zh: 而且最终拜登总统似乎之所以如此强调让她担任这一职务，

sentences.en: is there was a desire to have women leading and lead branches of the military.
sentences.zh: 是因为人们渴望看到女性领导军队及其分支机构。

sentences.en: What is the status under Hegseth, who is clearly not sharing that priority, of women in the leadership of the military?
sentences.zh: 在显然并不认同这一优先事项的海格塞斯领导下，女性在军队领导层中的现状如何？

sentences.en: Yeah, so this time, for the first time in at least a decade, if not longer, there will be no women nominated to admiral rank.
sentences.zh: 是的，这一次，至少在十年甚至更长时间以来，将没有任何女性被提名担任海军上将职务。

sentences.en: Women make up about 21% of the Navy, and so that means you've got a leadership of the Navy that increasingly looks less and less like the force that it oversees.
sentences.zh: 女性约占海军总人数的21%，这意味着海军的领导层越来越不像它所监管的这支部队。

sentences.en: I think, you know, it also means that young female officers who are coming up have fewer people who provide a sort of a pathway to success,
sentences.zh: 我认为，这也意味着正在崛起的年轻女性军官将拥有更少能够指引成功之路的人，

sentences.en: who show them what the opportunities available to them are.
sentences.zh: 来向她们展示有哪些可供利用的机会。

sentences.en: I think that's tough for them.
sentences.zh: 我认为这对她们来说很艰难。

sentences.en: I think it's also heartbreaking for people like Admiral Franchetti and other senior female officers who fought hard to get where they got.
sentences.zh: 我认为对于弗兰凯蒂海军上将以及其他为取得今天成就而奋力拼搏的高级女性军官来说，这也令人心碎。

sentences.en: Well, Greg, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，格雷格，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 不客气。

sentences.en: Thanks for having me.
sentences.zh: 谢谢邀请我来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。
